disposition: Full and snapshot backups write manifest-sealed archives with ordered digests, counts, and tenant scopes; restore verifies identity, refuses non-empty or unrelated targets, reopens with the same values, and emits the Recovery Receipt disclosing counts, duplicates, and limits. V2 uses its own manifest-directory archive (with compression at the schedule-bundle seam), not V1 zip/Deflate/Zstd.
